Is MakingOf the actual name of the forum? Or is that something else? 

I'm going to take a guess that what you've been hearing about is a movie sharing website that has been around for a long time and it's considered one of the most elite and difficult sites in that world to get into if you're a newb to that part of the high seas. 

That site also has an extremely active forum. 

Or maybe you're thinking about the old IMDB forums. Those were really good but gone to the ether now. 

Lastly, don't ask about invites to that forum. They frown on that big time. Search around and you'll find out how to get in. It is work. I'm not in there because I don't want to work for my I'll gotten content.

The name of the forum is Making Off, its been active for quite a while, ever since I got into lesser known movies the name of this online forum has popped up with certain frequency. As I have no ideia where to ask or who to ask for invites I had no option but to ask here hehe thanks for your feedback tho :)
